name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets are built to your exact specifications, offering unlimited choices in materials, finishes, sizes, and configurations to fit unique spaces perfectly. Semi-custom cabinets offer more options than stock cabinets but are manufactured in standard sizes with pre-defined modifications. While custom cabinets provide ultimate personalization and can address unusual room dimensions, they typically have a longer lead time and higher cost compared to semi-custom options. The practical tradeoff is between unique design flexibility and quicker availability with a more standardized approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to exact specifications for unique spaces; semi-custom offers more choices than stock but in standard sizes. The tradeoff is personalization versus availability and cost.
